div.head: Whiston’s chapter headings (compiled index)
div.note: These headings are transcribed from the 1856 Auburn and Rochester printing of William Whiston’s translation. Their arrangement as an index is editorial; this is not a reproduction of an original printed table of contents.

Book III headings 8 and 15 were directly print-verified on 9 October 2026 against the original 1856 scan and a separately held copy; earlier editions remain distinct controls. The governing-edition choice still awaits editorial approval.
div.head: BOOK III.
div.p: CONTAINING THE INTERVAL OF TWO YEARS.
FROM THE EXODUS OUT OF EGYPT, TO THE REJECTION OF THAT GENERATION.

list.label: I
list.item: HOW MOSES, WHEN HE HAD BROUGHT THE PEOPLE OUT OF EGYPT, LED THEM TO MOUNT SINAI; BUT NOT TILL THEY HAD SUFFERED MUCH IN THEIR JOURNEY.
list.label: II
list.item: HOW THE AMALEKITES, AND THE NEIGHBOURING NATIONS, MADE WAR WITH THE HEBREWS, AND WERE BEATEN, AND LOST A GREAT PART OF THEIR ARMY.
list.label: III
list.item: THAT MOSES KINDLY RECEIVED HIS FATHER-IN-LAW, JETHRO, WHEN HE CAME TO HIM TO MOUNT SINAI.
list.label: IV
list.item: HOW RAGUEL SUGGESTED TO MOSES TO SET HIS PEOPLE IN ORDER, UNDER THEIR RULERS OF THOUSANDS, AND RULERS OF HUNDREDS, WHO LIVED WITHOUT ORDER BEFORE; AND HOW MOSES COMPLIED IN ALL THINGS WITH HIS FATHER-IN-LAW'S ADMONITION.
list.label: V
list.item: HOW MOSES ASCENDED UP TO MOUNT SINAI, AND RECEIVED LAWS FROM GOD, AND DELIVERED THEM TO THE HEBREWS.
list.label: VI
list.item: CONCERNING THE TABERNACLE WHICH MOSES BUILT IN THE WILDERNESS FOR THE HONOUR OF GOD, AND WHICH SEEMED TO BE A TEMPLE.
list.label: VII
list.item: CONCERNING THE GARMENTS OF THE PRIESTS, AND OF THE HIGH-PRIEST.

list.item: OF THE PRIESTHOOD OF AARON1856 summary has no terminal point; independently confirmed in Toronto and Illinois copies. Earlier 1741 and 1784 points are edition variants.
list.label: IX
list.item: THE MANNER OF OUR OFFERING SACRIFICES.
list.label: X
list.item: CONCERNING THE FESTIVALS; AND HOW EACH DAY OF SUCH FESTIVAL IS TO BE OBSERVED.
list.label: XI
XII
XIII
list.item: HOW MOSES REMOVED FROM MOUNT SINAI, AND CONDUCTED THE PEOPLE TO THE BORDERS OF THE CANAANITES.
list.label: XIV
list.item: HOW MOSES SENT SOME PERSONS TO SEARCH OUT THE LAND OF THE CANAANITES, AND THE LARGENESS OF THEIR CITIES; AND FARTHER, THAT WHEN THOSE WHO WERE SENT WERE RETURNED, AFTER FORTY DAYS, AND REPORTED THAT THEY SHOULD NOT BE A MATCH FOR THEM, AND EXTOLLED THE STRENGTH OF THE CANAANITES, THE MULTITUDE WERE DISTURBED, AND FELL INTO DESPAIR; AND WERE RESOLVED TO STONE MOSES, AND TO RETURN BACK AGAIN INTO EGYPT, AND SERVE THE EGYPTIANS.
list.label: XV
list.item: HOW MOSES WAS DISPLEASED AT THIS, AND FORETOLD THAT GOD WAS ANGRY, AND THAT THEY SHOULD CONTINUE IN THE WILDERNESS FOR FORTY YEARS, AND NOT, DURING THAT TIME, EITHER RETURN INTO EGYPT, OR TAKE POSSESSION OF CANAAN.Complete 1856 wording and punctuation confirmed in original colour scan and separately held Illinois copy; remove the previous faded-reading hold without importing earlier punctuation.
